project: WO-B1 — Complete Antigravity Provider Execution with Real Offline AGY Golden Traces
description: Complete the existing ANTIGRAVITY provider so workers execute AGY 1.1.11 print mode through the canonical Provider and Worker boundaries, pass media paths directly to AGY, parse authoritative stream-JSON and structured JSON results with complete usage, reject refusal or contract-invalid outcomes, and prove the behavior offline with the real recorded AGY traces.

context.customerAsk: Enable modelProvider: ANTIGRAVITY workers to run workstation prompts such as watching an MP4 path and writing a review grounded in both video and audio, using existing Provider, Worker, and public contract boundaries and real offline AGY recordings.
context.problem: The repository has partial Antigravity identity, routing, PTY composition, and tests, but still lacks the recorded agy -p command behavior, mandatory --add-dir workspace exposure, media timeout and effort forwarding, authoritative result and usage parsing, structured output, and refusal-aware task outcomes. AGY may exit 0 and report SUCCESS after declining a task, so subprocess success can produce false task success.
context.solution: Finish the single Providers-owned Antigravity adapter: construct direct shell-free agy -p argv for every Worker dispatch, parse final stream-JSON results and JSON envelopes into existing provider-neutral results and diagnostics, use explicit structured response contracts for task success, and replay every real docs/temp/agy-traces asset through ProviderCommandRunner and root.BuildProcess in ordinary offline tests.

acceptanceCriteria: A worker configured with modelProvider: ANTIGRAVITY runs through the existing Provider, Worker, and public contracts and can review a prompted video path with output that reflects recorded visual and audio ground truth.

Because print-mode cwd is not the workspace, every dispatch uses the shell-free agy -p shape with --add-dir <working-directory> and forwards output format, optional schema, permissions, model, low|medium|high effort, and --print-timeout; timeout defaults to 5m and permits the recorded 8m media case, while model validation permits only gemini-3.6-flash-high, gemini-3.6-flash-medium, gemini-3.6-flash-low, gemini-3.5-flash-high, gemini-3.5-flash-medium, gemini-3.5-flash-low, gemini-3.1-pro-high, gemini-3.1-pro-low, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6-thinking, and gpt-oss-120b-medium from the recorded inventory.

Exit code 0 cannot establish task success; the final stream-JSON result is parsed for response, duration_seconds, num_turns, and input/output/thinking/cache_read/total usage, while JSON output supports conversation_id, status, response, structured_output, json_schema, and usage; malformed, incomplete, empty, and refusal outcomes produce non-empty actionable failures.

Offline golden coverage consumes docs/temp/agy-traces/agy-trace-simple-text.stream.jsonl, agy-trace-file-read.stream.jsonl, agy-trace-video-watch.stream.jsonl, agy-trace-structured.json, clip-fixture.mp4, groundtruth-fixture.mp4, agy-trace-groundtruth-verbose.stream.jsonl, agy-trace-clipqa-schema.stream.jsonl, agy-trace-missing-file.stream.jsonl, and README.md, never live AGY or invented fixtures, and asserts both recorded visual and audio facts including the deterministic ground truth.

AGY status SUCCESS cannot establish task success: because the recorded missing-file refusal appears only in prose, tasks requiring a verdict complete only from a present, valid, successful structured response contract; rate-limited AGY calls stay out of ordinary tests and at most one separately operator-gated live smoke is skipped by default.

Provider ownership, Worker consumption, injected effects, logging, and public contracts remain aligned; generated contracts are synchronized with make generate-api or make interfaces-all when applicable, and go test ./tests/functional/providers/agy/... -count=1, make verify-fast, applicable typecheck, lint, and tests pass.

The implementation and review loop continues until required CI is terminal and passing, every blocking PR conversation item is explicitly addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file changes are resolved, and the PR is actually merged; opened, green, approved, or ready-to-merge is not complete.

userStories.title: Dispatch the recorded AGY print command
userStories.description: As an operator, I want an Antigravity worker dispatch to reproduce the supported AGY headless command contract so its workspace, model policy, and execution limits are reliable.
acceptanceCriteria: A selected Antigravity worker invokes agy -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json as typed argv without shell interpolation and includes --disable-slash-commands.
Every invocation includes --add-dir <working-directory>, even when the subprocess working directory is the same path, and prompted file paths pass through unchanged for AGY to parse.

Worker model, canonical AGY effort low|medium|high, effective skip-permissions policy, and print timeout map to --model, --effort, --dangerously-skip-permissions, and --print-timeout; the default is 5m and media work can request at least 8m.
Supported model validation uses only the model inventory recorded in docs/temp/agy-traces/README.md, and unsupported model or effort values fail before launch with non-empty diagnostics.
ProviderCommandRunner tests prove exact argv and timeout behavior with the real file-read and video scenarios without live AGY.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented canonical shell-free agy -p print dispatch, workspace attachment, supported model/effort validation, permission and timeout forwarding, ProviderCommandRunner wiring, and offline file-read/video trace argv coverage. Focused provider, worker, wire, vet, and legacy AGY replay checks pass.

userStories.title: Parse authoritative stream-JSON results and usage
userStories.description: As a factory operator, I want the final AGY stream result converted into provider output and diagnostics so completed work and its cost are observable and trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter ignores non-terminal init, response, and tool-use records for final selection and parses the final event: result object as authoritative.

The result maps response, duration_seconds, num_turns, and input/output/thinking/cache_read/total token usage into existing Provider result, progress, and diagnostics contracts without dropping recorded zero values.

Empty streams, malformed JSON lines, missing final results, missing responses, truncated output, and nonzero process failures return deterministic non-empty safe diagnostics and never fabricate success.
Exit code 0 and result.status SUCCESS are retained as execution facts but cannot alone satisfy a task-level response contract.
Offline tests consume agy-trace-simple-text.stream.jsonl, agy-trace-file-read.stream.jsonl, and agy-trace-video-watch.stream.jsonl directly.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented bounded AGY stream-JSON parsing with terminal result selection, authoritative response/duration/turn/usage mapping, conversation session observation, strict malformed/incomplete output failures, and legacy PTY final-text compatibility. Real simple-text, file-read, and video traces plus malformed and zero-usage cases pass through the Providers root; provider/worker packages, vet, and AGY functional checks pass.

userStories.title: Enforce structured outputs and refusal-aware outcomes
userStories.description: As a workstation author, I want an output schema to become an AGY structured response contract so refusals and invalid verdicts cannot be mistaken for successful work.
acceptanceCriteria: A workstation output schema passes through --json-schema and selects the recorded JSON-capable output behavior that exposes conversation_id, status, response, structured_output, json_schema, and usage.
Valid structured output is returned in the form expected by existing Worker schema validation, and the echoed schema agrees with the requested contract.
A missing, malformed, schema-invalid, or explicitly failing structured verdict produces a task failure with non-empty diagnostics even when process exit is 0 and AGY status is SUCCESS.
The clip-QA schema preserves action_completed, spec_deviations, temporal_artifacts, audio_content, unexpected_speech, verdict, and confidence and returns the recorded pass verdict.
Offline tests consume agy-trace-structured.json, agy-trace-clipqa-schema.stream.jsonl, and agy-trace-missing-file.stream.jsonl directly.

When public contracts change, authored contract sources and generated Go and TypeScript consumers are synchronized with the applicable repository generation command and generated files are not hand-edited.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented AGY structured-output mode and contract enforcement: schema-bearing dispatches use --output-format json with validated --json-schema, while stream-json traces remain supported for recorded clip-QA runs; the parser now exposes and verifies structured_output/json_schema, normalizes valid structured output into Provider content, and rejects missing, malformed, or mismatched contracts with actionable failures. Worker execution now validates arbitrary authored JSON Schema documents and turns explicit reroll/failure verdicts into permanent bad-request task failures. Offline tests replay agy-trace-structured.json, agy-trace-clipqa-schema.stream.jsonl, and agy-trace-missing-file.stream.jsonl directly. Focused and full provider/worker tests, AGY functional tests, and provider/worker vet pass; no public contracts changed, so generation was not applicable.

userStories.title: Complete multimodal Worker execution through the factory boundary
userStories.description: As a customer, I want an Antigravity-backed worker to watch a video path and produce a review grounded in both the picture and soundtrack so media quality gates judge the actual artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: A factory built through root.BuildProcess selects the canonical Antigravity Provider from modelProvider: ANTIGRAVITY and dispatches through existing Worker and Provider services without another ACP or provider lane.

Functional tests replace the external command effect only through edges.Edges.ProviderCommandRunner, replay real AGY traces, and observe argv, Provider response, Worker result, Factory events, and terminal Work outcome.
The deterministic video case asserts 4.000 seconds, 320x240, 100 frames at 25 fps, PHASE 1, PHASE 2, the red-to-blue cut at 2.000 seconds, and the 440.00 Hz tone ending in silence at 2.000 seconds.
The real clip case asserts its visual review plus ambient drone, clock ticking, and no speech; paths remain prompt text and no wrapper-layer multimodal transform is added.
The missing-file refusal reaches failed Work with actionable diagnostics rather than completed Work despite exit 0 and AGY SUCCESS.
Offline functional coverage consumes clip-fixture.mp4, groundtruth-fixture.mp4, agy-trace-groundtruth-verbose.stream.jsonl, and the other relevant real traces without live AGY.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added root.BuildProcess functional golden coverage for the canonical ANTIGRAVITY Provider through the injected ProviderCommandRunner. Offline clip and ground-truth video traces now assert exact AGY argv/workspace, provider session identity, response facts, usage counters, Worker dispatch output, Factory observations, and terminal Work. A real missing-file refusal with exit 0 and AGY SUCCESS is asserted as failed/rejected Work with actionable output. Provider response metadata and public-safe numeric usage projection are preserved across the Provider and Worker boundaries; focused provider, worker, diagnostics, vet, and AGY functional tests pass.

userStories.title: Deliver reproducible offline verification and one gated live smoke
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a deterministic verification path and a separately gated live probe so CI remains reliable and the installed AGY integration can still be checked intentionally.
acceptanceCriteria: The exact offline command go test ./tests/functional/providers/agy/... -count=1 passes from real traces and never invokes an installed AGY binary.
make verify-fast and applicable focused typecheck, lint, unit, integration, and contract checks pass.

The separately named operator-only command is $env:YOU_AGY_LIVE_SMOKE='1'; go test ./tests/functional/providers/agy/... -run '^TestAgyLiveSmoke$' -count=1; it is skipped unless gated, excluded from ordinary CI behavior, and is the only live AGY smoke.
The operator smoke proves one minimal supported end-to-end invocation and reports an actionable skip or failure when credentials, executable, or quota are unavailable.
If authored OpenAPI or shared schemas change, make generate-api or make interfaces-all is run as appropriate and generated consumers remain synchronized.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented the single operator-gated TestAgyLiveSmoke through the canonical root.BuildProcess path with the real platform subprocess runner, supported gemini-3.6-flash-low recipe, actionable executable skip, and authentication/model/quota failure diagnostics. Ordinary AGY functional tests remain offline and pass, and the gated test skips by default. Locked UI dependencies were restored; verify-fast now passes typecheck, MCP contract checks, and all UI tests but remains blocked by the pre-existing Windows pkg/platform/runtimeartifact mode assertion (0666 vs 0600) in the short Go suite, while make lint remains blocked by the repository's existing backend-size baseline. Story remains false until the required repository gates are green.
